file_insights.changes_summary: Added bulk operation modal UI and implemented bulk action methods in Alpine.js orderManager
key_additions: New 'Bulk Status Change Modal' with Portuguese labels for bulk operations
executeBulkAction() async method for processing bulk requests
isBulkOperation flag to distinguish bulk vs single operations
key_modifications: Updated confirm modal text logic to handle both bulk and single operations
Modified startOrder() and completeOrder() to set isBulkOperation = false
Enhanced executeAction() to route to executeBulkAction() when needed
Improved error handling with error.message in catch block

patterns_discovered.description: Uses isBulkOperation flag to determine execution path (bulk vs single). Confirms via executeAction() dispatcher method rather than direct calls.
Opens bulkStatusModalOpen for selection, closes it, then opens confirmModalOpen for final confirmation. Maintains state between modal transitions.
All UI text, button labels, and messages use Portuguese language. Consistent with existing codebase convention.

patterns_discovered.pattern: Response validation with partial success handling
patterns_discovered.description: Bulk API response includes success counts (started/completed) and failed count. Constructs detailed success message accounting for partial failures.
Includes X-CSRFToken header in fetch POST requests using Django template variable {{ csrf_token }}.
patterns_discovered.frequency: Both single and bulk operation requests

gotchas_discovered.description: Two separate modal-backdrop divs for bulkStatusModalOpen (lines 511, 512). This is redundant and could cause z-index/stacking issues. Standard pattern appears to be single backdrop per modal.
executeBulkAction() calls this.clearSelection() after bulk completion but this method is not shown in the diff. Assumes method exists elsewhere in orderManager object.
Bulk action URLs depend on Django template tags {% url "production:order_batch_start" %} and {% url "production:order_batch_complete" %}. Backend routes must exist and match these names.
executeBulkAction() calls window.location.reload() on success, forcing full page refresh. This clears all component state and is a heavy-handed approach to state synchronization.
selectedOrders array populated and cleared via external methods (not visible in diff). Bulk operations depend on this being properly maintained across user selections.

approach_outcome.implementation_strategy: Added UI components and JavaScript methods to enable bulk operations through a two-modal confirmation flow. Used state flags to differentiate bulk vs single operations and routed accordingly.
approach_outcome.completeness: Fully implemented with modal UI, state management, and async bulk action handler
approach_outcome.scope_coverage: Covered both bulk start and bulk complete operations with appropriate messaging for Portuguese locale

recommendations.recommendation: Remove duplicate modal-backdrop divs. Each modal should have exactly one backdrop element to prevent rendering/stacking issues.
Replace window.location.reload() with selective state refresh. Fetch updated order data via API and update selectedOrders array instead of full page reload.
recommendations.rationale: Preserves user state, faster UX, and allows for optimistic UI updates

recommendations.recommendation: Display error messages in modal/toast instead of alert(). Current alert() blocks interaction and is poor UX for bulk operations with multiple failures.
Extract modal state variables (bulkStatusModalOpen, confirmModalOpen, isBulkOperation) and related methods into a separate Alpine.js store or composable for better maintainability.
recommendations.rationale: Growing complexity of state management warrants separation of concerns

recommendations.recommendation: Add validation to ensure backend URLs exist and respond correctly. Consider fallback behavior if routes are not defined.
